languages.name: Registry Standard
languages.description: The city's paperwork tongue: flat, precise, full of subsections. Everyone speaks it; nobody dreams in it.

languages.name: Wolof
languages.description: A market language of traders and storytellers, quick with proverbs.

languages.name: Tagalog
languages.description: A market language heard all along the Lantern Arcade, bright with borrowed words.

languages.name: Arabic
languages.description: A market language of spice sellers and haggling, spoken in several dialects.

languages.name: Cantonese
languages.description: A market language of the food carts and the chip stalls, fast and tonal.

languages.name: Hindi
languages.description: A market language of the lodging houses and tea stands.

languages.name: Portuguese
languages.description: A market language of the docks and the old trading families.

languages.name: Protocol
languages.description: The enclaves' spoken code: clipped, structured, half of it acknowledgements. Sounds like polite static to outsiders.

languages.name: Underside Cant
languages.description: The tongue of Old Vesper's forgotten, full of words for things that no longer exist. Hard to hear clearly, harder to remember.

languages.name: Animal-speech
languages.description: What awakened animals speak with their own kind: chirps, flicks and silences that mean far more than they seem.
